parameters.content:
## Weekly scorecard

An extension, not part of the core loop.

Every Friday afternoon Scout counts what landed in your signal map over
the last seven days and emails you one summary: new signals, warmth
mix, replies, and which rows moved.

Targets live in **Scout Setup** under **weeklyTargets**. They are your
numbers, not defaults you have to justify. Set them to zero if you do
not want to be scored.

Scout emails only you. It contacts nobody in the report.

## Configure before running

1. Open **Scout Setup** and set your Notion database id and the address
   that should receive the scorecard.
2. Bind a Notion credential on both query nodes and a Gmail OAuth2
   credential on **Email Scorecard**.
3. Adjust **weeklyTargets**. Each value is a whole number from 0 to
   1000.

New signals are counted from Notion's own page creation time, so you do
not need an extra date property.

This workflow ships with its timezone set to **UTC**. Change the
workflow timezone before you activate the schedule.

## Limits worth knowing

**One page per query.** Both Notion queries ask for 100 rows and v0.1
does not follow the pagination cursor. A week with more than 100 new or
100 touched rows is undercounted. Paginate before you rely on these
numbers for anything that matters.

**A quiet week still sends.** If both queries come back empty you get a
short "no activity" scorecard rather than a failed execution.

Names and links come out of Notion and are HTML-escaped before they
reach the email. Only http and https links become clickable.
